Coverage: malformed closed inputs; cyclic/oversized/expired requests with no observation outputs; builder preservation of route, demand, occurrence edges and original reading; explicit source-anchor availability; tampered route rejection; and enriched missing-provider records with no asserted slice/proof body. Readonly API scout complete for assignment #533. Full exact paths/lines, source-map shape and comparison, feasible binding order, consumer/API findings, cap inventory, and limitations are in `.codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/provider-expansion/scout.md` (SHA-256 `d03ad154d99ef53c2333abf8f940fcd899f3096caf9127eee850deb3b79134be`).

Known source-level candidates: exact `alternateBound s x` appears in `ThreeSteps.endpoint` at fixture lines 33–35 (a parent-body call, not provider-body expansion); `firstBound` uses `simp` at lines 17–19, where `Nat.le_refl` is plausible but unverified. No Lean/extraction/tests were run; root owns checking exact occurrence and worker/resource behavior. No canonical/frozen edits or dependencies; baseline evidence untouched.
